categories.main_business_segments: Jiangsu Jibeier Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd. primarily engages in pharmaceutical research and development, manufacturing, and sales. Its product portfolio includes tablets, capsules, and eye drops targeting various therapeutic areas such as leukocyte enhancement, hypertension, immune enhancement, joint diseases, eye infections, bronchitis, and liver protection. The company is also focused on innovative drug development for depression, tumors, and gastrointestinal diseases.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced technologies including compound formulation development, deuterated drug technology, and liposome drug delivery platforms. It has developed proprietary synthesis and quality control methods for key products like Likojun tablets and Niqunluo tablets, supported by multiple national patents. Manufacturing strictly adheres to GMP standards with a focus on quality assurance and process optimization.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Jibeier serves hospitals, retail pharmacies, and healthcare providers across China. Its products are widely used in departments such as oncology, cardiology, endocrinology, infectious diseases, and respiratory medicine. The company’s key markets include treatment of leukopenia, hypertension with high heart rate, and other common diseases, with growing penetration in tumor and depression treatment segments.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily within China, with sales covering major regions including East China, Central China, Southwest, North China, South China, Northeast, and Northwest. Its marketing and distribution network effectively covers these regions through multiple offices and a comprehensive sales force.
categories.supply_chain_position: Jibeier operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the pharmaceutical supply chain, focusing on drug development, manufacturing, and distribution. It controls the production of active pharmaceutical ingredients (APIs) and finished dosage forms, and sells products through established distribution channels to end customers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes innovation in drug development, focusing on high-impact therapeutic areas such as oncology, depression, cardiovascular, and metabolic diseases. It invests heavily in R&D, with ongoing clinical trials for novel drugs like JJH201501 (antidepressant) and JJH201601 (anti-tumor). Strategic collaborations with universities and CROs enhance its innovation capabilities. The company also advances digital transformation and smart manufacturing.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through product sales of pharmaceutical formulations including tablets, capsules, and eye drops. Sales are conducted via a combination of academic promotion and distribution through qualified pharmaceutical distributors to hospitals and retail pharmacies. The company also benefits from government healthcare insurance reimbursements for certain products.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Jibeier is positioned as a high-tech pharmaceutical company with a strong focus on innovative drugs and proprietary technologies. It holds leading market positions in specific segments such as leukocyte-enhancing drugs and compound antihypertensive drugs. Its patented products like Niqunluo tablets have no generic competition domestically, reinforcing its competitive edge. The company is recognized as a national-level specialized and innovative 'Little Giant' enterprise.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenues of approximately RMB 896.5 million, representing a 4.14% increase year-over-year. Net profit attributable to shareholders was about RMB 219.3 million, stable compared to the previous year. Total assets grew by 14.39% to RMB 2.53 billion, and net assets increased by 18.05% to RMB 2.25 billion. R&D investment rose to 7.85% of revenue, reflecting a growth-oriented profile.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Jibeier emphasizes high-quality, innovative pharmaceutical products with strong clinical efficacy and safety profiles. Its proprietary technologies, such as deuterated drugs and liposome formulations, extend drug half-life and reduce side effects. The company’s products like Likojun and Niqunluo tablets offer unique therapeutic benefits and enjoy strong patent protection, ensuring market exclusivity and clinical preference. Comprehensive quality management and a robust marketing network further differentiate its offerings.
